exact_prompt: Create a transparent 2-column by 1-row orthographic projection atlas for the exact wooden training dummy in the source. LEFT cell is TOP (camera straight down, +Z): show the dummy's square wooden floor platform as a square footprint, with its central post/head and crossbar foreshortened into a centered T-shaped plan. RIGHT cell is BOTTOM (camera straight up, -Z): show the same square wooden platform underside as a square footprint, wood planks and dark edging; the platform occludes most of the dummy body, with only any genuinely protruding lower base/post visible. In BOTH cells, the base must be square wood planks like the source, never a circular black-rimmed target disc. Preserve source's warm oak/orange wood, dark outlines, rivets/details, proportions and pixel-art style. Exact axis-aligned orthographic views, no perspective or isometric. Transparent background in both cells, equal square cells, clear vertical divider/gutter, no labels and no other objects.
